name: Geunsonsil Olkka Bwa Pamyeorendingeun Geojeolhamnida
source:
A 530,000 combat SHSL personal trainer is reincarnated as a villainess?! “Guillotine in a year? I’ll tank it with my traps.”A chaotic gain-seeking survival comedy romance fantasy visual novel about a character who fears muscle loss more than death.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4843520/I_Refuse_the_Bad_Ending_for_fear_of_Muscle_Loss/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
战斗力高达53万的“超高校级”私人健身教练，居然转生成了恶役千金？！“一年后就要上断头台？看我用斜方肌硬扛下来！”这是一部把掉肌肉看得比死还可怕的狂热增肌求生喜剧奇幻恋爱视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4843520/I_Refuse_the_Bad_Ending_for_fear_of_Muscle_Loss/]Steam[/url]]
